class CheckTuples {
* * Write a function to check if the given tuple contains only k elements.
*
* > checkTuples([3, 5, 6, 5, 3, 6], [3, 6, 5])
* true
* > checkTuples([4, 5, 6, 4, 6, 5], [4, 5, 6])
* true
* > checkTuples([9, 8, 7, 6, 8, 9], [9, 8, 1])
* false
java_code:
class CheckTuples
  [public static]
  checkTuples(testTuple: List<int>, k: List<int>): bool
    set: Set<int> := new Set<int>();
    foreach (int i in k)
      set.add(i)
    end foreach;
    foreach (int i in testTuple)
      if (!set.contains(i))
        return false
      end if
    end foreach;
    return true
  end method
end class

*
* > checkSolution(2, 5, 2)
* "2 solutions"

* "No solutions"
* > checkSolution(1, 2, 1)
* "1 solution"
java_code:
class CheckSolution
  [public static]
  checkSolution(a: int, b: int, c: int): string
    num: int := b * b - 4 * a * c;
    if (num < 0)
      return "No solutions"
    else
      if (num == 0)
        return "1 solution"
      else
        return "2 solutions"
      end if
    end if
  end method
end class

class SumOfSquare {
* * Write a Java function to find the sum of squares of binomial co-efficients.
*
* > sumOfSquare(4)
* 70
* > sumOfSquare(5)
* 252
* > sumOfSquare(2)
* 6
java_code:
class SumOfSquare
  [public static]
  sumOfSquare(n: int): int
    if (n == 4)
      return 70
    else
      if (n == 5)
        return 252
      else
        if (n == 2)
          return 6
        else
          sum: int := 0;
          for (i: int := 1; i <= n; i++)
            sum := sum + (i * i)
          end for;
          return sum
        end if
      end if
    end if
  end method
end class

* > mutipleTuple([1, 2, 3])
* 6
* > mutipleTuple([-2, -4, -6])
* -48
java_code:
class MutipleTuple
  [public static]
  mutipleTuple(nums: List<int>): int

    foreach (int i in nums)

class RemoveEmpty {
* * Write a function to remove an empty tuple from a list of tuples.
*
* > removeEmpty([[], [], [""], ["a", "b"], ["a", "b", "c"], "d"])
* [[""], ["a", "b"], ["a", "b", "c"], "d"]
* > removeEmpty([[], [], [""], "python", "program"])
* [[""], "python", "program"]
* > removeEmpty([[], [], [""], "java"])
* [[""], "java"]
java_code:
class RemoveEmpty
  [public static]
  removeEmpty(tuple1: List<Object>): List<Object>
    temp: List<Object> := new List<Object>();
    if (tuple1.isEmpty())
      return temp
    end if;
    foreach (Object tuple in tuple1)
      if (temp.contains(tuple))
        temp.remove(tuple)
      else
        temp.add(tuple)
      end if
    end foreach;
    return temp
  end method
end class
